title: Otherwise you're just a machine
description: As AI becomes increasingly capable at design tasks, this essay challenges designers to develop uniquely human skills that machines cannot replicate. Explores what separates exceptional designers from automated solutions and why continuous skill development is critical in an AI-driven design landscape.

title: Inkling 2 Small
description: A breakthrough AI model that can visually understand and refine what it creates, representing a significant leap in AI's ability to iterate on design and development work autonomously. This advancement has major implications for how designers and developers will collaborate with AI tools.

title: Muse Realtime Avatar
description: Transforms voice conversations into live video calls with realistic avatars, opening new possibilities for remote communication and interaction design. This technology challenges designers to rethink how we approach presence and engagement in digital conversations.

title: Rex (Beta)
description: A new multiplexer platform designed to unify fragmented work tools and processes across teams. Addresses a critical pain point in modern product workflows and has significant implications for how UX and product teams structure their daily operations.

title: Sequence Tool
description: Enables users to edit long recordings into polished stories using natural language commands, democratizing video editing for non-professionals. This innovation exemplifies how AI is transforming creative workflows and user expectations around content creation.

title: RSS Club: CSS-Tricks Redesign Preview
description: A prominent design resource undergoes a significant redesign, providing valuable insights into modern web design practices and priorities. The behind-the-scenes perspective on redesign decisions offers learning opportunities for designers managing similar projects.

title: Zigzag Browser
description: A native Mac browser positioned as a polished alternative to Arc, representing the continued innovation in browser design and UX. Demonstrates how even mature product categories continue to evolve with fresh design approaches and user experience improvements.

title: A sans serif built on oversized round shapes
description: Superior Type's Heaven represents bold typography experimentation with brutalist design sensibilities and unconventional proportions. A case study in how contemporary typeface design pushes boundaries and influences brand identity and visual communication strategies.
